name: Yuffie, Materia Hunter
oracle_text:
Ninjutsu {1}{R} ({1}{R}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
When Yuffie enters, gain control of target noncreature artifact for as long as you control Yuffie. Then you may attach an Equipment you control to Yuffie.
blocked_sentences: Ninjutsu {1}{R} ({1}{R}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)

needs.what: ninjutsu as 702.49 defines it: activatable only once blockers have been declared (509.1h -- before that no attacker is "unblocked"), and the ninja attacking the same player, planeswalker or battle the returned creature was attacking (702.49c), read from the creature the cost returned
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the cookbook shape (activated from hand, cost return_to_hand {attacking: true, blocked: false}, put_onto_battlefield attacking: true) is offered in the declare attackers step, because the `blocked` selector reads 'no blocker recorded' rather than 'blockers declared and none for it' (tests/unit/keywords/test_ninjutsu.py pins that it is offered before blocks), so the ninja can be swapped in before blocks and then be blocked; and `attacking: true` resolves through board_helpers._attack_defender to the first declared attacker's defender, not the returned creature's, and never copies its attacking_permanent -- in a multiplayer pod the ninja can attack the wrong player, or a player instead of the planeswalker
